title: Wet-Ink Signature Document Staging and Location
reference_docs: Mission Control Decisions (signature gate); mission-control/data/signing-locations.json; Exos DocuSign User Instructions
remarks: Directed by John Quinn 2026-10-26 (D-7282192 / MC #4026). Approved by John Quinn.
objective: The purpose of this procedure is to ensure every document that needs a wet-ink signature is filed in a known, labeled location (File Cabinet number, Drawer, and Folder) and that the location is stated in the signing instruction so the signer can find and sign it without asking.
overview: Any Mission Control Decision or instruction asking a person to sign must state where the document is. For e-signature this is the e-sign link. For wet ink it is the exact physical location in the form: <Site> office, File Cabinet <N>, Drawer <N>, Folder <Decision ID or document title>. Mission Control rejects signature Decisions whose location lacks the cabinet, drawer, or folder. Signing cabinets are listed in the Signing Locations Register (mission-control/data/signing-locations.json). At Greenville, Drawer 1 holds documents awaiting signature and Drawer 2 holds signed documents awaiting scan and filing.

tasks.name: Task 1 - Designate and register the signing cabinet
steps: Designate one file cabinet at each site for documents awaiting signature and label it File Cabinet <N> - TO SIGN.
Label Drawer 1 'Awaiting Signature' and Drawer 2 'Signed - To Scan/File'.
Record the site, cabinet number, and drawer uses in the Signing Locations Register in Mission Control.

tasks.name: Task 2 - Stage the document for signature
steps: Print the final, current version of the document. Confirm it is the latest version on the Mission Control task.
Place it in a folder labeled with the Decision ID (D-number) and document title, and flag every signature and initial line.
File the folder in Drawer 1 of the registered signing cabinet.

tasks.name: Task 3 - Issue the signing instruction
steps: Create the signature Decision or instruction with documentLocation in the form: <Site> office, File Cabinet <N>, Drawer <N>, Folder <D-number / title>.
For e-signature, give the e-sign link instead of a physical location.
Confirm the location appears on the Decision card as 'Document to sign: ...'.

tasks.name: Task 4 - Sign, return, and close out
steps: Signer retrieves the folder from the stated cabinet, drawer, and folder, signs, and places the folder in Drawer 2.
Scan the signed document, attach it to the Mission Control task, and file or route the original per the records owner.
Mark the Decision answered and the folder slot empty. Remove the folder from Drawer 2 once filed.
